about-intro:
Web developer specializing in interactive 3D web experiences and real-time systems.
Builds scalable, high-performance applications that combine engaging visuals with seamless functionality using WebGL, TypeScript, and Node.js.
about-tagline: 3D Artist for assets, props and environment, stylized texture, set lighting, shaders with hands-on experience in game layout/map. Skilled in turning requirements 3D model into game engine: Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot... and collaborating effectively across teams to deliver reliable products.
assets-subtitle: Explore interactive 3D models with Blender-standard Base Color and clean 4-sided Quad wireframe topology without triangle diagonals.
assets-desc: Collection of 10 interactive 3D environment concepts. Click and drag or touch to rotate 360°, scroll to zoom, toggle Wireframe mode to inspect topology. Fully compatible in scale and units with files imported/exported from Blender 5.2 (textured FBX & GLB).
